propositions: When a child's direct parent is non-epic and the Jira project permits only Epic parents, the parent field is suppressed outbound but no context breadcrumb points the user to the nearest represented ancestor.

An echo-safe breadcrumb comment must be appended exactly once via stable tag identity, carrying both RECONCILER_MARKER for inbound suppression and a deterministic link to the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key.
The breadcrumb emission logic must walk the local parent hierarchy upward from a type-collapsed child to find the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key, skipping intervening unbound ancestors.
Append-once dedup via stable identity tag <!-- rebar:parent-breadcrumb --> ensures no conflicting duplicate comments even if the nearest represented ancestor changes across reconciliation passes.

The breadcrumb implementation integrates into _diff_comments (outbound comment differ) with new optional parameters local_parents and local_ticket_types; existing callers and tests remain unchanged when these parameters are absent.
Inbound echo-safety is enforced by RECONCILER_MARKER substring check in _diff_comments_inbound, preventing re-ingestion of the breadcrumb on subsequent inbound sync.
